（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL · JUNCTA IN UNO）

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. 6.
I. O. REG
No. 130
Date 28 - 2 - 16
February 28th 1916

Sir,
Since the second revolution the breach blocks of the guns at Woosung have been kept at the Arsenal. As a result of an application recently made by General Lu, Deputy Military Governor of Shanghai, to Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang, the latter recently gave instructions to have the gun parts referred to returned to Woosung. These instructions were carried out yesterday when the breach blocks were taken to Woosung by boat.
It is reported that the military authorities of Shanghai intend to build a new fort between Woosung forts and Sz Ts Ling forts.
General Lu, Deputy Military Governor, has given orders to Li Tsung Nyoh 李宗森 Director of the Arsenal Works to make four 7 cm. machine guns for use in Woosung and Sz Ts Ling 狮子林.
Two robbers named Zau Koh Woo 趙國華 and Zee Yu Soon 徐如松 who were concerned in a Frenchtown case were shot at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.
Commencing from yesterday the police on duty in the vicinity of the City Central Police Station have instructions to search to search all pedestrains whom they meet in the locality mentioned after 9 p.m.
A circular signed by Mr. Stepharius was sent to German, Austrian and Turkish subjects in Shanghai asking them to refrain from subscribing to the "China Press" as that paper was now being run against the Germans.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Taken on M.S. Feb. 29.
From by A.P.

中央登记处

（印章：上海工部局 · 合众为一）

警务处，
（侦探股）

总监

上海工部局。

C. I. 6.
I. O. REG
编号 130
日期 16年2月28日
1916年2月28日

先生：

自二次革命以来，吴淞炮台的火炮炮闩一直存放在兵工厂。鉴于上海副都督卢将军最近向蒋尊簋（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）（音译）提出申请，后者近日指示将上述火炮部件归还吴淞。该指令已于昨日执行，炮闩已乘船运往吴淞。

据报，上海军方打算在吴淞炮台与狮子林（Sz Ts Ling）炮台之间修建一座新堡垒。

副都督卢将军已命令兵工厂主任李宗森制造四门7厘米机枪，供吴淞和狮子林使用。

两名涉及法租界案件的劫匪，名为赵国华（Zau Koh Woo）和徐如松（Zee Yu Soon），于昨日下午在兵工厂被枪决。

自昨日起，在市中心巡捕房附近执勤的巡捕奉命，对晚上9点后在上述地区遇到的所有行人进行搜查。

一份由斯蒂法里乌斯先生（Mr. Stepharius）签署的通函已发送给在上海的德国、奥地利和土耳其籍人士，要求他们不要订阅《大陆报》（China Press），因为该报目前正从事反德活动。

您顺从的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警务处总巡官。

由 A.P. 于2月29日录入 M.S.
